Bellissimo. A great little Italian restaurant in Dalat
Jul 2025 • Family
Lovely service and a real Italian ambience upstairs. Excellent sized 30cm crispy pizzas with generous toppings (not excessive) and delightful desserts of panna cotta and chocolate cake. House wine was fine too. The price was excellent too for us Australians. 

Only thing that let it down was the cafe latte which was too large, too hot and tasteless. Then again it’s been impossible getting a piccolo or flat white in Vietnam where they use the expresso function of the espresso machine.

Tired of Noodles
Feb 2025 • Solo
I was looking for a burger for lunch, and walked by this place. It seemed promising, so I noted its location and returned gor a late dinner. Being from the outskirts of New York City, my standards for pizza are high, bordering on snobbish. I had the pizza with spicy salami. The waitress explained that the salami was not spicy, but that they added crushed red pepper as a finishing touch. 

The pizza was delicious, on a light crust and baked in a stone oven. If you get tired of noodles and oddly seasoned street food, this place is a fantastic alternative.
